description: Find local service businesses near a US ZIP code: "appliance_repair" (Appliance repair), "dryer_vent_cleaning" (Dryer vent cleaning), "used_appliances" (Used & scratch-and-dent appliances), "appliance_store" (Appliance store), "duct_cleaning" (Air duct cleaning), "hvac" (Heating & air conditioning (HVAC)), "plumbing" (Plumbing), "electrical" (Electrical), "roofing" (Roofing), "landscaping" (Landscaping, lawn, tree & irrigation), "cleaning" (Cleaning (home, office, carpet, pressure washing)), "pest_control" (Pest control), "locksmith" (Locksmith), "painting" (Painting), "garage_door" (Garage door repair), "handyman" (Handyman), "pool_spa" (Pool & spa service), "restoration" (Water, fire & mold restoration), "concrete_masonry" (Concrete, masonry & paving), "fence" (Fencing), "gutters" (Gutters), "septic" (Septic service), "chimney" (Chimney sweep & repair), "junk_removal" (Junk removal), "home_inspection" (Home inspection), "flooring" (Flooring), "windows_doors" (Windows & doors), "security_systems" (Home security systems), "remodeling" (Remodeling), "insulation" (Insulation), "solar" (Solar installation), "well_drilling" (Well drilling & pumps), "towing" (Towing & roadside), "auto_repair" (Auto repair), "collision" (Collision & auto glass), "diesel_truck" (Diesel & truck repair), "power_sports" (Motorcycle, marine & small engine), "welding" (Welding & fabrication), "machine_shop" (Machine shops & CNC), "computer_repair" (Computer & phone repair / IT), "heavy_equipment" (Excavation & heavy equipment), "trucking" (Trucking), "aquarium" (Aquarium service & fish). For appliance services, optional brand (e.g. "sub-zero"), appliance (e.g. "refrigerator") and problem (e.g. "dryer not heating", "Samsung dE code") narrow it and matching free repair guides are returned first (other trades ignore them). Each result has a trust tier, distance, phone, profile link and Trust Card link (what AssistAnt verified, how and when). Commercial-only shops are left out unless segment is "commercial".

problem.description: What is wrong, in the person's words, including any error code
